name: Autofolio
subtitle: Car & Fuel Tracker
summary: Fuel, charging, maintenance, and mileage. Your vehicle's whole story, in one organized place.
description: Meet your offline-first garage companion. Autofolio brings fuel logs, EV charging, running costs, vehicle documents, and manual mileage together, so you can spend less time sorting records and more time getting where you want to go.
features: A log for every powertrain
Record refuels and EV charges with quantities, prices, odometer readings, and notes. Follow consumption and cost per kilometre or mile.
Maintenance, without the guesswork
Keep services, repairs, tires, and recurring bills together. Set reminders by date, odometer, or whichever comes first. Optional notifications are date-based; mileage limits are checked in the app.
Documents in their place
Attach photos or PDFs for insurance, registration, inspections, and warranties. Track expiry dates alongside your other reminders.
Mileage you control
Manually log business and personal trips using start and end odometer readings. No GPS recording, background location tracking, or automatic tax-deduction calculation.
Receipts to records
Scan Latin-script receipts on-device to pre-fill a fuel or charging entry, then review before saving. Import CSV records and export CSV or JSON.
Your garage, backed up
Create local backups with attached photos and documents. Pro adds PDF reports and vehicle passports. Backups are not encrypted, so protect files you save or share.
steps: Set up your garage
Add your vehicle, preferred units, and currency.
Make your first entry
Log a refuel, charge, service, or trip.
See the bigger picture
Review running costs and set your next reminder.
privacySummary: Vehicle records and supported imports are processed on your device. There are no ads, behavioral analytics, or location tracking. Backups are not encrypted. Stores handle purchases, reviews and Android updates; files you share are handled by the recipients you choose.
faqs: What is included for free?

Free mode includes two vehicles, including inactive ones, and five lifetime saved receipt scans. The optional lifetime Pro purchase adds unlimited vehicles and receipt scans, PDF reports, vehicle passports, and alternative themes.
Does Autofolio sync across devices?
Automatic cross-device sync is not available. Core tracking works offline, and you can create and restore local backups. Backup files are not encrypted.
Is Pro a subscription?
No. Lifetime Pro is a one-time in-app purchase where available. Current pricing is shown in the app and may vary by region.
Which languages are supported?
English, German, French, Spanish, Hindi, Urdu, and Arabic, with right-to-left support for Urdu and Arabic.

name: 5 Prayers
subtitle: Adhan Times
tagline:
A little calm.
Five times a day.
summary: Prayer times, Qibla direction, and thoughtful reminders that fit into your everyday routine.
description: Make space for salah with daily prayer times, a Qibla compass, flexible adhan reminders, and saved locations. Adjust the details to your practice, keep a timetable close, and carry a calmer routine with you.
features: Your day, at a glance
View daily prayer times and the countdown to the next prayer for your selected location.
Find your direction
Use the Qibla compass for direction guidance. The compass uses heading or sensor readings available on your device.
Reminders on your terms
Choose the prayers and reminder offsets that work for you. Enable optional notifications and supported Android exact-alarm access.
Home and away
Find a location manually or use device location. Save the places you return to for easy switching.
Fine-tune your timetable
Adjust calculation methods, Asr settings, high-latitude rules, prayer offsets, and Hijri preferences. Add iqama times where needed.
Keep prayer times close
Use home screen widgets and generate monthly PDF timetables on your device to save, open, or share.
steps: Choose your location
Use device location or search for a place manually.
Make it yours
Select your calculation settings and reminder preferences.
Stay in your rhythm
Check the next prayer, use a widget, or save a monthly timetable.
privacySummary: Prayer preferences and saved locations are primarily stored on your device. Location and sensor data power the features you choose. There are no in-app ads or dedicated analytics SDKs in the current release.
faqs: Do I have to allow location access?
No. You can deny device location permission and use manual location search instead. Search and geocoding lookups may be processed by the platform's location services.
Can I customize the prayer times?
Yes. The app supports calculation-method choices, Asr and high-latitude settings, prayer adjustments, Hijri adjustments, and related display preferences.
Are there ads or an account?
There are no in-app ads and no account is required. Optional one-time support purchases are processed by Google Play or Apple.
Can I share a monthly timetable?
Yes. The app generates a PDF on your device. If you open or share it, the receiving app or service handles that copy under its own privacy practices.

name: Konvertr
subtitle: Unit Converter
summary: A quick, uncluttered unit converter for the everyday and the surprisingly specific.
description: From metric and imperial measurements to data and engineering units, Konvertr makes conversions feel effortless. With 25 categories and 421 unit entries bundled for offline use, your next answer is always close.
features: Everyday measurements
Convert common metric and imperial measurements without searching the web.
Beyond the basics
Work with data and engineering units alongside your everyday conversions.
Ready without a connection
Core conversion data is bundled with the app, so ordinary conversions work offline.
Precision your way
Set decimal points, precision, sorting, and layout preferences to suit your workflow.
Straight to the answer
No sign-in, advertising, or embedded analytics tools get between you and a conversion.
Room to grow
Need favorites, history, a calculator, and extra utility tools? Explore the separate Konvertr Pro app.
steps: Pick a category
Choose the type of measurement you need.
Enter your value
Select the source and destination units.
Get your answer
Use the result, with precision set the way you prefer.
privacySummary: Konvertr stores preferences locally and does not collect personal information for transmission to Mishmash Labs. The optional Pro upgrade link opens an external store, which has its own privacy practices. App stores handle optional reviews.
faqs: Does it work offline?
Yes. Core unit conversions use locally bundled conversion data and work without an internet connection.
What is the difference between Konvertr and Pro?
Konvertr is the free, focused unit converter. Konvertr Pro is a separate paid app with a calculator, favorites, conversion and calculator history, themes, multi-view workflows, and 19 utility tools.
Do I need an account?
No. Konvertr does not require an account and does not include advertising, analytics, or crash-reporting SDKs in the reviewed release.

name: Konvertr Pro
subtitle: Units & Tools
tagline:
One small app.
A whole toolkit.
summary: Conversions, calculations, and 19 handy tools. A little more power for your everyday.
description: Keep a useful toolkit in your pocket. Konvertr Pro pairs offline unit conversion with a built-in calculator, favorites, history, and practical utilities, all in a flexible, ad-free workspace.
features: The full converter
Convert across 25 categories and 421 unit entries with offline conversion data.
Calculate in the same place
Use the built-in calculator and revisit calculator history without switching apps.
Keep what you use
Save favorite conversions and return to your converter history for repeat tasks.
Everyday number tools
Access utilities for BMI, BMR, age, salary, tax, and splitting tips, alongside other practical tools.
Time and direction
Use date, time-zone, and compass tools. Optional tools read relevant device information locally to power their features.
A flexible workspace
Choose themes, preferences, and multi-view layouts that suit how you work.
steps: Start with a conversion
Choose your category and units, then enter a value.
Build your shortcuts
Save favorites and revisit recent calculations.
Explore your toolkit
Open a utility tool and adjust the workspace to your needs.
privacySummary: Settings, favorites, and history stay locally on your device. There are no advertising, analytics, or crash-reporting SDKs in the reviewed release. Optional compass and time-zone tools use limited device data locally. App stores handle optional reviews.
faqs: Is Konvertr Pro a separate app?
Yes. It is a separate paid app, available through Google Play and the App Store. The store listing shows current pricing for your region.
Does Pro need an internet connection?
The main app is designed to work offline. Conversion data, saved favorites, and histories are held on your device.
Does it need sensitive permissions?
Normal use does not require camera, microphone, contacts, SMS, or location permissions. Optional tools may use orientation sensors or your device's time-zone identifier locally.

name: Explore Lahore
subtitle: City Guide
summary: Find your next favorite corner of Lahore, then turn a few good ideas into a great day out.
description: A local-first guide for curious days in Lahore. Browse curated places and themed collections, save your favorites, and build an itinerary that moves from morning plans to evening discoveries.
features: A city worth exploring
Discover curated places and themed collections, with practical details to help you choose where to go.
Find your kind of place
Search by name, area, and tags to narrow down your next outing.
Keep a little shortlist
Save favorite places and revisit recently viewed spots without creating an account.
Plan a whole day
Arrange stops in morning, afternoon, and evening slots, then share your itinerary through an app you choose.
Remember where you've been
Keep a personal visit history, including saved visit dates, on your device.
Useful details, close by
Find maps, websites, social links, and seasonal tips. External links open services with their own privacy practices.
steps: Find some inspiration
Browse collections or search for a place.
Make it a plan
Save favorites and arrange your itinerary.
Go explore
Open a map, share your plan, and keep your visit history.
privacySummary: Favorites, itineraries, and visit history are stored locally, with no GPS permission. Google services handle ads, consent and font downloads. The app can fetch guide updates from GitHub Pages and Android app updates through Google Play. App stores handle optional reviews.
faqs: Do I need an account or GPS access?
No. An account is not required, and Explore Lahore does not request runtime device-location permission. Map links open a third-party service.
Can I use the guide offline?
Core place data ships with the app and your saved plans are local. Ads, font downloads, external websites, maps, and automatic guide-data refreshes need a connection.
Are there ads?
Yes. The app uses Google Mobile Ads in selected areas and Google's consent flow where required. Available privacy choices can be reviewed in the app.
Can I share my itinerary?
Yes. The app passes your selected itinerary to the system share sheet, where you choose the receiving app or person.

name: Word Sleuth
subtitle: Logic Word Games
tagline:
Follow the clues.
Find your aha.
summary: Eight ways to play with words. A pocket-sized workout for your inner detective.
description: Make connections, crack ciphers, and follow a little curiosity. Word Sleuth brings eight single-player word puzzle modes together, with saved progress, statistics, and achievements to keep your discoveries going.
features: Bridge the gap
Explore Word Bridge and Logic Deduction for connections, clues, and satisfying logical leaps.
Build with letters
Try Letter Lattice and Fragment Forge for a different angle on word construction.
Crack the pattern
Take on Cipher Lock and Category Matrix to decode clues and organize connections.
Untangle the answer
Play Lexical Extraction and String Resolution to find what is hiding in the letters.
Pick up where you left off
Save puzzle progress locally and follow your statistics, streaks, and achievements.
A little extra with Pro
The optional Pro upgrade removes ads and adds benefits including saved hints, challenge swaps, and cabinet customization.
steps: Choose a puzzle mode
Start with the kind of word challenge you enjoy.
Work the clues
Connect, decode, or rearrange your way to an answer.
Keep your streak going
Return to saved progress and explore another mode.
privacySummary: Gameplay progress and preferences are saved locally, with no account required. The free version uses Google AdMob. Backups are shared only at your request and are not encrypted. Fonts and store services may make network requests; there is no dedicated Firebase Analytics integration.
faqs: Which puzzle modes are included?
Word Bridge, Logic Deduction, Letter Lattice, Fragment Forge, Cipher Lock, Category Matrix, Lexical Extraction, and String Resolution.
Is my progress saved?
Yes. Puzzle progress, statistics, achievements, and preferences are stored on your device. Clearing app data or uninstalling may remove that local progress, subject to platform backup behavior.
What does Pro add?
Pro removes ads and unlocks additional benefits, including saved hints, challenge swaps, and cabinet customization. The app shows the current purchase details.
Does the app use analytics?

The current app does not include Firebase Analytics or a dedicated remote crash-reporting SDK. Google advertising services may still process ad measurement and diagnostic information. The privacy policy explains these services and your choices.

name: proFPL
subtitle: FPL Manager
tagline:
Your team.
Your next big call.
summary: Live points, smarter planning, and your squad in one place. Make every gameweek count.
description: Your independent companion for Fantasy Premier League. Follow live gameweek points, manage your squad and transfers, explore player information, and keep an eye on the fixtures before your next big decision.
features: Follow your gameweek
Track live points and dashboard information as your Fantasy Premier League gameweek unfolds.
Your squad, your decisions
Manage lineup, bench, captain, and chip choices with your connected FPL account.
Think through your transfers
Explore player profiles, comparisons, and transfer tools before making your next move.
Look ahead
Review fixtures and results to put your upcoming gameweeks in context.
Keep up with the competition
Browse leagues, cups, standings, and related team information.
Don't miss the deadline
Set optional local gameweek reminders and choose your preferred light, dark, and color themes.
steps: Choose how to connect
Sign in to FPL, view a public Team ID, or try Explore.
Review your gameweek
Check your squad, points, players, and upcoming fixtures.
Make your next move
Sign in for account actions and set a reminder ahead of the deadline.
privacySummary: FPL sign-in connects directly to Premier League services; public Team ID viewing needs no password. Saved credentials use secure storage. Google handles ads and consent. RevenueCat manages purchases and receives the active FPL entry ID. Widgets use public team data; there is no Firebase Analytics integration.
faqs: Do I need to sign in to Fantasy Premier League?

You can view public information using a Team ID or Explore without entering a password. Sign in with an existing FPL account for private information, Pick Team and Transfers. An internet connection is needed; proFPL does not create or operate your FPL account.
Is this an official Premier League app?
No. proFPL is an independent companion and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the Premier League or Fantasy Premier League.
What is proFPL Plus?

Plus is an optional upgrade with monthly and yearly subscriptions and a lifetime purchase option. A valid Plus entitlement suppresses ads. Available features and localized prices are shown in the app.
How are saved accounts handled?

If you choose to save an account, credentials and reusable session information use your device's platform secure storage. You can remove saved accounts in Settings. Never send passwords or authentication tokens in a support message.
disclaimer: proFPL is independent and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with the Premier League or Fantasy Premier League.
